title: 홈 수입 비행기 현황(도착 공지 + 입고 기록 → 상태·예측 위치·이슈) 계약 — 읽기 전용

crossYearFixture.description: 입고 기록은 정규화한 AWB와 업무연도·세부차수로 묶는다. 같은 AWB의 전년도/차수 데이터를 사용할 수 없다. 인보이스 확인본은 수입부 기존 권한과 WarehouseKey/업무연도/세부차수/완료된 문서 revision으로 연결한다.

dnspyEvidence.source: nenova.exe 에는 없는 웹 전용 조회. ERP 테이블 side effect 없음(전부 SELECT). 운송장 번호는 FormWarehouse 입고 원장의 주문번호(OrderNo) 칸에 저장된 값을 읽기만 한다.
methods: WarehouseMaster.OrderNo(운송장 번호) 존재 여부로 '입고 등록 끝' 판정(읽기)
WarehouseDetail.BoxQuantity 합계와 Product.FlowerName 으로 실린 품목 표시(읽기, 운임 품목 3100·3101·2182 제외)
인천공항 운항 정보(공공데이터포털)와 관세청 유니패스 통관 진행은 외부 공개 API 조회만 한다(읽기, ERP 무관)
서류 전달 표시는 data/runtime/import-flight-docs.json 파일에만 저장한다(MSSQL 쓰기 없음)
카톡 도착 공지는 Orbit 읽기 통로(nenova-import-schedule-feed)에서 받아 해독만 한다 — ERP 등록 승인이 아님

presentation.issues: No standalone issue table. Exact full-flight identity joins issues into each flight card. Urgent current flights first. The map and map-only dialog show departure-pending and in-flight statuses only. Arrival verification and post-arrival tasks remain separately visible. Registered flights without linked issues are collapsed.
presentation.details: Shared numbered map markers and cards; keyboard selection highlights route and expands the matching card. Unknown location is not invented. Compact defaults show cargo, completed-step count, quarantine deadline and first two actions. Expanded cards retain all issues, waybill, work steps and evidence. Card titles show country, deduplicated flower groups from the exact AWB, arrival year and sub-week receipt or parsed flight notice, and sub-week. Expanded cards expose any abbreviated list. Registered receipt quantities and reviewed invoice revision quantities retain their separate sources and units.
presentation.sideEffects: Kakao original-message resolution, conservative airport-date matching and display only. Existing warehouse SELECT and explicit docs flag unchanged. All ERP ledgers preserved.
presentation.scheduledCheck: Codex thread automation automation-2, daily 09/12/15/18 Asia/Seoul including weekends; linked-page results reported in chat, not written to ERP.
presentation.resolution: A structured schedule may be preceded by a schedule-room notice with explicit country, arrival date/time, air waybill, flight and carton count. Its unknown sub-week is kept until the exact waybill/flight/country/arrival-day notice supplies it. Current schedule equivalence across rooms; explicit docs receipt resolves docs requests, not quantity discrepancies. Explicit correction resolves the corresponding issue. Guessed/approximate links never prove completion. ERP registration or 48h age never resolves an open operational request.

mapSelection: Nearby map label hit areas are separated with leader lines to the unchanged projected anchors; identity retains year/full key. Web and Desktop share placeMarkers. Map background or the zoom button opens a map-only dialog. Marker selection in either view activates its flight card without opening the dialog.
